page_title: PIS 0-1 PAR | Pisa v Parma 08/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Daniele Doveri has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Mandela Keita (Parma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+3' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
90+2' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathias Lovik (Parma) replacing Gaetano Oristanio.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Pisa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

89' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Edoardo Corvi, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Pisa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
89' Pisa fail to score from a corner as Edoardo Corvi (Parma) leaps to collect the ball.

88' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
85' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
84' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) replaces Henrik Meister.
82' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
82' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:8.
76' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Arturo Calabresi.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lorran (Pisa) is coming onto the pitch as Gabriele Piccinini cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) coming on for Adrian Benedyczak.
75' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Adrian Bernabe Garcia is replaced by Christian Ordonez (Parma).
74' A pass by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
73' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
71' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
68' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Michel Aebischer (Pisa) for his blatant foul.
67' The corner from Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is intercepted by the defence.
63' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Edoardo Corvi pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
62' Pisa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 8:6.
59' Substitution. Jacob Ondrejka makes way for Oliver Sorensen (Parma).
58' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.

55' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
54' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
51' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
50' Pisa couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Edoardo Corvi (Parma) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
49' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
47' A snap shot by Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
46' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Marius Marin will be replaced by Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa).
46' Substitution. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) in, Samuele Angori out.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45+2' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
41' The referee Daniele Doveri awards Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) a yellow card.
40' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Simone Scuffet no chance!
40' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
39' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
39' Referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
39' Surely that's handball by one of the Pisa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
37' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Simone Scuffet makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
34' Samuele Angori (Pisa) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
32' A lofted cross from Idrissa Toure (Pisa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Pisa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
29' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
27' Samuele Angori (Pisa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
21' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
20' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
18' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.

13' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Simone Scuffet anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
13' Samuele Angori (Pisa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
9' The ball is cleared after Henrik Meister (Pisa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
5' He should have done better. Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) is afforded space to connect with a Emanuele Valeri cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well wide of the right post.
3' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Pisa will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniele Doveri.
